mentions.claim_text: He says that for what he saw, Trump is going to be in the White House and is going to help them.
mentions.quote: for what I saw he's going to be in the white house
mentions.falsify_match: Trump wins the 5 November 2024 presidential election.
mentions.falsify_miss: Trump loses. Base rate: in April 2024 Trump led most national and swing-state polls, so a win was close to an even or better bet.

mentions.claim_text: Four days before the vote he says he has seen it so clearly that Trump wins, that it is settled in the spirit realm, and that they will see a victory.
mentions.quote: president Trump wins and I've seen it
mentions.falsify_miss: Trump loses. Base rate: final forecasts were near even, with prediction markets leaning Trump, so this is a call on a near coin flip.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will try to rig the election in Brazil and that he sees corruption in Brazil, then declares it too big to rig.
mentions.quote: They'll try to rig the election in Brazil. I see corruption in Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: Brazil's electoral authorities, courts or independent observers find material fraud in the October 2026 presidential vote.
mentions.falsify_miss: The vote is certified with no material fraud found. A losing candidate's allegation is not a finding.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that change is coming to Brazil, in the same passage as the rigging warning.
mentions.quote: For change is coming to Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: The incumbent government is replaced at the October 2026 election.
mentions.falsify_miss: Lula is re-elected. Declared in prayer, so scored as the outcome it asked for, not as a vision.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows for a fact he saw three gunny sacks full of fraudulent paper ballots in a metal garage, planned in advance, about Brazil's election.
mentions.quote: I saw three gunny sacks full of fraudulent uh paper ballots
mentions.falsify_match: Officials or courts find fraudulent paper ballots in the 2026 Brazilian election.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such finding. Said on 26 October, a day after the runoff, while showing coverage of the paper-ballot fallback, so it is partly after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed them to pray for the conservative candidate with a heart like David in Brazil's election, and that they would try to rob him of the election.
mentions.quote: pray for that conservative guy. He has a heart like David
mentions.falsify_match: The conservative candidate wins Brazil's runoff.
mentions.falsify_miss: The conservative loses. Said on 26 October, after the runoff.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the good Christian conservative man wins Colombia's election by a landslide and cleans house.
mentions.quote: that man, the good Christian man, would win by a landslide in Colombia
mentions.falsify_match: The conservative candidate wins Colombia's 2026 presidential election by a wide margin.
mentions.falsify_miss: The conservative loses, or wins narrowly. A prayer, so it is recorded as the outcome asked for, not a forecast.
